identity_confirmation.description: Resolve and pin the canonical GRCh38-shaped SPDI and transcript alias for the candidate variant against the bound disease pack's allowed genes/assembly/transcript pins. Produces candidate_variant for AtlasCandidateImport.

literature_retrieval.description: Retrieve public, appropriately licensed literature and dataset records relevant to the confirmed identity, restricted to the bookshelf's public_licensed_sources.

claim_span_extraction.description: Extract candidate mechanistic claims with exact source spans (locator/exact_quote/page_or_figure) from retrieved documents. Produces proposed_claims and proposed_sources for AtlasCandidateImport.

contradiction_search.description: Search extracted claims and retrieved documents for direct contradictions and register any conflicts for the duplicate/conflict promotion gate.

assay_context_normalization.description: Normalize each claim's experimental context (assay, model system, cell type, tissue, zygosity, assay limitations) against the pack's declared context vocabulary.

evidence_gap_mapping.description: Map remaining assay/evidence gaps and unknowns not resolved by prior steps, for downstream human-oracle review before promotion.
